text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
One day after classes are over, I spot
Nishino
Flower and some others studying
in a classroom.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Biko, you see how the instructions here
say,
"Solve for x"?

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
What that means is that you need to
rearrange
the equation so that the x is
by itself on one side!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Um... Huuuh? Now I'm even more
confused...

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Like I said, the answer's x = 3!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
But why is that the answer? And why did
you
move x to the left side anyway?

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Well, that's because... You can't get the
answer if
you don't move it there.

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
You're acting like you know everything,
but you
don't get it either, do you?

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: I do too!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: U-um... Hm, how should I explain it...

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Oh, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
We're doing our homework together,
but I'm not
sure how to teach them in a
way they'd
understand...

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
I just followed what our teacher taught
us in
class...
choice_data_list: How did you figure that out?
How did you figure that out?

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Wait, that's it!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
I always take notes on everything in
class, so go
ahead and use them as
reference!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Oh, I see! The plus and minus get
switched here!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
What, you mean we were just adding
and
subtracting stuff this whole time?!
This will be
easy peasy, then!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
I've gotta say, though, your notes are
awesome!
They're easier to understand
than our teacher's
explanations!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Totally! You use different colors for
different
stuff too. Just looking at these
notes is fun. ♪

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
You're exaggerating. All I did was listen
to the
teacher and copy down what was
on the board.

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Nuh-uh! We're being totally serious! I
write
everything down too, but my notes
are all a big
mess. How do you do it?

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: There's no trick to it, really.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
I just make sure to write neatly so that
anyone
can read them, not just me.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Taking the time to write carefully is like
doing my
future self a favor when I
review the notes later
on.

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Wow! But I guess you did us a favor this time. ★

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha, true. I'll have to keep taking

well-organized notes so that I can help
everyone
out even more.

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
That settles it! The next time I don't get

something, I'll just take a peek at
Flower's notes!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Hey! You can't just count on her for
everything!
You have to study yourself,
too!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
That's fine by me. Be sure to let me
know
whenever something has you
stumped!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Everyone needs a helping hand now and
then.

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Wow! ♪ You sounded so mature just
now,
Flower! ★

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: I did? Ehehehe, thanks!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
But I wouldn't have known what to do
without
your advice, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
But I wouldn't have known what to do
without
your advice, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
D-do you really think so?! Wow! Hearing
that just
made my day.
choice_data_list: It's all thanks to your diligence.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
I'm going to study even harder from now
on, just
you watch!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Okay! I've got to make sure I take
thorough notes
tomorrow, too!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Really? Thank you so much!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
But... I'd feel bad if I relied on you for
everything.
All things in moderation,
right?

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
choice_data_list: Don't worry about it. We help each...

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Tehehe, thanks! Okay, I'll be counting
on you,
then!
